# opalstack_psqldb (Resource)

A PostgreSQL database. Only the lists of users change in place. Deleting the database deletes its data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opalstack_psqldb" "shop" {
  name      = "shop"
  server_id = data.opalstack_server.web.id
  user_ids  = [opalstack_psqluser.shop.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the database. Changing it replaces the database.
- `server_id` (String) UUID of the server the database lives on. Changing it replaces the database.

### Optional

- `charset` (String) Character set, such as `utf8mb4` for MariaDB or `utf8` for PostgreSQL. Left out, the API chooses. Changing it replaces the database.
- `readonly_user_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the PostgreSQL users that may only read. Left out, the list is empty on a new object and is left as it is on an existing one.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `user_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the PostgreSQL users that may read and write. Left out, the list is empty on a new object and is left as it is on an existing one.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the database.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By name, or by UUID.
terraform import opalstack_psqldb.shop shop
terraform import opalstack_psqldb.shop 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
